$comment: connector-catalog-ui (ADR-037 register fragment). Adds the catalog_item schema — a browsable, register/schema-backed metadata record describing a real, already-shipped connector adapter, seeded source template, or importable configuration template. Materialised by lib/Repair/MaterializeCatalogItems.php from CatalogRegistryService::collect(), which reads (a) OpenRegister's IntegrationRegistry, (b) a small static descriptor list for adapters not yet registered there (PDOK/Digikoppeling/Berichtenbox/DSO), and (c) the register.d/*-source.json seed fragments. catalog_item objects carry NO credentials — only display metadata — so, unlike `source` (99-source-lockdown.json), this schema is left at the default authorization (readable by any authenticated user), matching the Catalog page's browse-for-everyone intent; writes happen only via the repair step and the admin-gated CatalogController#instantiate/enable actions (ADR-023 catalog.instantiate). See openspec/changes/connector-catalog-ui/design.md.

catalog_item.title: Catalog Item
catalog_item.summary: A browsable catalog entry describing a real connector adapter, seeded source template, or importable configuration template
catalog_item.description: One row per real, already-shipped adapter/source/template, materialised by MaterializeCatalogItems from CatalogRegistryService::collect(). No entry is invented — every catalog_item corresponds to code already in the repository. See openspec/specs/connector-catalog/spec.md#requirement-a-single-php-side-adapter-metadata-registry-is-the-source-of-truth-for-catalog-entries-req-003.

slug.description: Stable identifier this catalog item is keyed/upserted by, namespaced by kind (e.g. `adapter:s3-data-infra`, `source-template:brp-haalcentraal`) so re-materialisation updates in place instead of duplicating.
slug.title: Slug

name.description: Display name shown on the catalog card
name.title: Name

description.description: Full description shown in the detail dialog
description.title: Description

category.description: Category facet used by the Catalog page's category filter (e.g. "Geo / Maps", "Government registers", "Data infrastructure")
category.title: Category

mechanism.description: How this item's dormancy/availability is controlled: flag-gated reads an app-config feature flag (flagKey); mock-seeded reads the underlying Source's isEnabled/configuration.mock; always-available items (e.g. the OR IntegrationRegistry category adapters) have no gate.
mechanism.title: Mechanism

flagKey.description: App-config key checked live for flag-gated items (e.g. "pdok.feature_flag"). Empty for other mechanisms.
flagKey.title: Flag Key

sourceTemplateSlug.description: Slug of the seeded Source object this item instantiates/enables, for mock-seeded and source-template items. Empty for adapter items with no backing Source.
sourceTemplateSlug.title: Source Template Slug

status.description: Status computed by CatalogRegistryService::resolveStatus() and cached at materialisation time so the Catalog grid can facet-filter/render without a live per-card check; CatalogController#status re-checks live on detail-dialog open so a flag flip between repair-step runs is never stale in the modal.
status.title: Status

standards.description: Standards/protocols this item implements (e.g. "OGC WMS", "Haal Centraal BRP")
standards.title: Standards

icon.description: MDI icon name (without mdi- prefix) shown on the card
icon.title: Icon
